info.name: Razorpay Bills X Payout Links API

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Filter payout links by the contact ID of the recipient.

params.name: from
params.description: Unix timestamp. Only payout links created from this timestamp onwards are returned.

params.name: to
params.description: Unix timestamp. Only payout links created before this timestamp are returned.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of payout links to return. Default: 10.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of payout links to skip. Use for pagination. Default: 0.

items.docs: List all payout links. Filter by contact ID, status, or date range.
Send a payout link to a contact when fund account details are unavailable. expire_by must be at least 15 minutes in the future.

params.name: payout_link_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the payout link (e.g. `poutlk_00000000000001`).

items.docs: Fetch details of a specific payout link by its ID.

params.name: payout_link_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the payout link to cancel.

items.docs: Cancel a payout link that is in `issued` or `pending` state.
